stories.title: Release the Cursed Drider
stories.summary: Deliver the golden engraved dragon statue to the drider for experience and the adamantium-and-mithril spider key. The local preparation exchanges are optional when a valid statue is supplied. The reward key fits the runed chest and master-bedroom belt pouch.

steps.text: Carry the adamantium spider key for the War Room
steps.hint: Kalaban exchanges four spider eggs for this key. It opens the door north of the Hall of Redemption. The key is access guidance; an existing open route or supplied key also works.

steps.text: Trade four spider eggs with Kalaban
steps.hint: Optional access preparation. A supplied key or another valid access route does not require this receipt.

steps.text: Have the drider prepare the two potion statues
steps.hint: Optional recipe: one robin tail feather and one glowing ivy leaf. A supplied final statue does not require this receipt.

steps.text: Have Kalaban combine the two potion statues
steps.hint: Optional recipe: one blood-red manticore and one blue sea serpent. Return the resulting golden dragon statue to the drider.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a golden engraved dragon statue
steps.hint: The two local potion-statue exchanges prepare this item. Keep it for delivery; another valid statue also works without earlier receipts.

steps.text: Deliver the golden dragon statue to the drider
steps.hint: Return to the War Room with the exact statue. This terminal delivery gives experience and the reward key; earlier exchanges alone do not complete the story.

stories.title: Prepare the Two Statues
stories.summary: Bring the drider one robin tail feather and one glowing ivy leaf for a blood-red manticore and blue sea-serpent potion statue. Take both to Kalaban for the remedy. This preparation service does not add a separate story achievement.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a robin's tail feather
steps.hint: The red-breasted robin by the pond carries this feather. A valid supplied feather also works; possession is not a personal kill or recovery achievement.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a strangly glowing ivy leaf
steps.hint: Golden ivy in the eastern glade carries this glowing leaf. The dialogue calls it petals, but the accepted ingredient is the leaf. Valid supplied leaves work too.

steps.text: Give the feather and ivy leaf to the drider
steps.hint: He gives the blood-red manticore and blue sea serpent. Keep both for Kalaban instead of drinking them.

stories.title: The Spider Eggs and the Hidden Key
stories.summary: Bring Kalaban four unhatched spider eggs for experience and the adamantium spider key. This key opens the War Room north of the Hall of Redemption; it differs from the drider's container key.

steps.text: Carry 4 x some unhatched spider eggs
steps.hint: Sword spiders in the upper sleeping chambers carry the eggs. Bring four separate items; supplied eggs are accepted without personal sourcing proof.

steps.text: Give four spider eggs to Kalaban
steps.hint: Kalaban gives the adamantium spider key and experience. The key is for War Room access, not the runed chest or belt pouch.

stories.title: Combine the Statues
stories.summary: Bring Kalaban the blood-red manticore and blue sea-serpent potion statues. He combines them into the golden engraved dragon statue for delivery to the drider. This is a preparation service, not the terminal release.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a blood-red glass manticore
steps.hint: The drider prepares this potion statue from a robin feather and glowing ivy leaf. A valid supplied statue also works. Keep it for the exchange instead of drinking it.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a blue sea serpent statue
steps.hint: The drider prepares this potion statue from a robin feather and glowing ivy leaf. A valid supplied statue also works. Keep it for the exchange instead of drinking it.

steps.text: Have Kalaban combine the two statues
steps.hint: Deliver the resulting golden dragon statue to the drider for the terminal reward. Combining the statues alone does not release him.

introduction: Follow the traces of an ancient elven home, meet its surviving inhabitants, and uncover a remedy for the cursed drider.
orientation: Explore with look and exits, inspect gates and wall hangings, and search for concealed passages. Some doors respond to spoken words.
Two spider-shaped keys have different uses. Read their full descriptions: the adamantium key opens the War Room; the key made of adamantium and mithril opens reward containers.
Local ingredient and statue exchanges offer preparation routes. Valid supplied materials are accepted; live possession does not prove personal recovery.

contacts.name: a half-elf, half-spider creature
contacts.description: Follow his life, fighter, and help conversation, then answer yes for the ingredient request. His no response is a rebuke; the native exchanges do not record a permanent refusal.

contacts.name: Kalaban the aging hermit
contacts.description: Ask about spiders to learn of the eggs. He offers the War Room access key and combines the drider's two potion statues into the remedy.
